nodes.label: SLOOP Editor (web/editor.html)
nodes.rationale: Felucca/SLOOP web editor: one file, no libraries, runs from file:// too (fonts inlined). The FM-1's screen on a big display: black, four track colours, the device's Terminus pixel font at 16/32 px only. ?mock=1 uses a built-in simulated device.

nodes.label: Embedded SLOOP Terminus font (base64 TTF, L17)
nodes.rationale: Inlined as a data: URL (~100 KB line) so the editor also runs from file://; generated by tools/gen_webfont.py.

nodes.label: Fukiai icon font + GLYPH map
nodes.rationale: Hügelton Instruments' MIT icon font; icons hidden (html:not(.fk)) until the face has loaded, words only on failure.

nodes.label: TEXT i18n dictionary (ja / en)
nodes.rationale: All UI strings in Japanese and English; language from navigator.language, toggled by the lang button.

nodes.label: Sound page (engine, presets, FM6 panel, drum panel)
Sequencer page (step grid, piano roll, drum grid)
Local browser audio preview (mock only)
nodes.rationale: Plays the mock device's state in the browser (preview.js LocalPreview); keys, pads, inline sequence editing, note dialog.

nodes.label: Punch-in effects (27 FX, LIVE.FX_NAMES)
nodes.rationale: 16 on the white keys, 11 on the black keys (punch.c PUNCH_NAME); play only while held.

nodes.label: LIVE pro scenes / morph / crossfader
nodes.rationale: Editor-only: scenes kept in the browser, recalled at once, morphed over bars or mixed with A/B crossfader; every value through TRACK_MIX / TRACK_PARAM / SET.

nodes.label: felucca-library JSON format
nodes.rationale: Parameters mapped by label key so a firmware with other ids still gets right values; engines matched by name.

nodes.label: sloop-song file format
nodes.rationale: A song as one file: loop (object 0), sections A..D (2..5) and the order (36 bytes of settings at 48); the LIVE playlist is a list of these.

nodes.label: SET coalescing (SetGate)
nodes.rationale: Same value skipped only while the request is pending; once answered the same value is sent again (2.6 DIV bug fix).

nodes.label: Link (strict request/response queue)
nodes.rationale: One frame in flight, rest queued; key-coalescing; push frames can arrive between request and reply and go to onPush.

nodes.label: loudDb()
nodes.rationale: K-weighted (ITU-R BS.1770) loudest 100 ms window: a hit is heard by its loudest moment.

nodes.label: backupRestore()
nodes.rationale: Refuses before writing anything when the backup's projects are newer than the device reads; skips objects 8-11 a device lacks.

nodes.label: FM6 module (6-op voice pack/unpack, SysEx, bank)
makeMockDevice()
nodes.rationale: Implements the protocol like firmware/src/editor.c with tables from params.c and engine sources; options simulate older firmware (legacy, v3..v11).

nodes.label: G_SKIP (globals shown as buttons or hidden)
selfReload (skip RELOAD pushes the editor caused)
LVS (LIVE pro state: scenes, MIDI map, favs, grid)
LVP() (LIVE track param ids by label)
LVG() (LIVE global param ids by label)
Web MIDI connect / port probing
nodes.rationale: Tries each FM-1 port pair until one answers INFO (a generic port name may be other gear); first frame after opening can be lost, so INFO is retried.

nodes.label: Live sync via WATCH pushes (protocol v2)
nodes.rationale: Device pushes CHANGED / RELOAD / STEP_CHANGED; editor PINGs ~1/s so the watch (ends 3 s after last request) stays on, and DUMPs every 5 s as a safety net.

nodes.label: DUMP polling fallback (older firmware)
nodes.rationale: Without WATCH: DUMP every 400 ms and two steps per round, since steps are not in DUMP.

nodes.label: SET coalescing (one in flight, one queued per key)
nodes.rationale: SET as fast as the device answers: Link coalesces by key so a drag never builds a backlog; the user's value wins over pushes/polls while touched.

nodes.label: Self-caused RELOAD suppression
nodes.rationale: The device pushes RELOAD after loads the editor asked for; the editor re-reads anyway, so it skips that many RELOADs for 1.5 s.

nodes.label: Sound page (parameter cards per device button)
nodes.rationale: Known firmware layouts get cards per device button (ENV, LFO, EDIT...) with pages as rows of four knobs; unknown layouts fall back to id order.

nodes.label: Drum track sound panel (2.7, LIVE op 12)
nodes.rationale: Pad TUNE/DECAY changes made locally win for DP_HOLD (1.5 s) so a stale reply or poll never pulls a knob back while it moves.

nodes.label: THEME page (firmware v11, backup object 11)
nodes.rationale: Preview drawn through RGB565 as the FM-1 shows it; unreadable themes are refused by the FM-1 so Send says why and offers Fix.

nodes.label: DRUM SYNTH page (firmware v10, SYN1..SYN4)
nodes.rationale: Every change goes to the FM-1's RAM at once (voices play from there); STORE writes the four kits to flash only with the song stopped.

nodes.label: Song page (section order A..D via settings backup object 1)
Step nudge, parameter locks and fill conditions (v7/v8)
Samples page (USR1..USR4 slots, files or CHOP)
LOOP+TAIL sample loops (2.7)
nodes.rationale: A held loop goes round; on release the rest plays to the end, as the FM-1 plays it; loop points snap to zero crossings.

nodes.label: Drum kit builder (16 pads -> USR slot, USR3+4 big kit)
nodes.rationale: A slot of the pair that gets no pad is erased so nothing old plays on a lane the kit leaves empty.

nodes.label: CHOP tool (slice a recording into keys)
nodes.rationale: TAP markers are placed on what the listener hears (output latency compensated) and snapped to the nearest hit.

nodes.label: Mixer strips (TRACK_MIX / TRACK_PARAM, v3/v4)
nodes.rationale: Selected track's level/pan/mute are also Sound parameters so both views follow each other; v3 firmware pans other tracks by briefly selecting them.

nodes.label: Patch library (IndexedDB felucca-editor)
nodes.rationale: Without IndexedDB (some private windows) the library is kept in memory only; patches stored with another layout are remapped by key.

nodes.label: FM6 patch editor (firmware v9, SysEx import/export)
nodes.rationale: Send to track makes it the track's own patch at once; Store in bank keeps it in PTCH slot B1..B27 (flash, song stopped).

nodes.label: FM6 cartridge store (ticked voices -> B1..Bn, optional user presets)
nodes.rationale: Bank read whole (backup object 8), slots replaced, written back whole in one BK_PUT flash write.

nodes.label: LIVE page (2.7, protocol v12)
nodes.rationale: Button actions go through LIVE (same firmware code as the buttons); notes as plain MIDI notes so no SysEx sits between a key and its sound; state read ~8x/s while shown.

nodes.label: LIVE pro (scenes, morph, crossfader, PERFORM, MIDI learn, stage tools)
Scenes with morph over bars and A/B crossfader
nodes.rationale: Only values that differ are sent, queued by key, so a morph's later value replaces one not yet sent.

nodes.label: PERFORM card (sound/arp/fx/steps of the target track)
MIDI learn (data-lvm controls on any controller CC/note)
Set recording from FM-1 USB audio (AudioWorklet -> WAV)
LIVE newcomer guide, card help and tips
PWA offline service worker and install prompt
nodes.rationale: Opened once online the editor works offline on https; a downloaded file opened as content:// on Android has no MIDI in Chrome.

nodes.label: Keep-alive PING and re-WATCH after gaps
nodes.rationale: After a long gap (hidden tab, flash write: Link.onGap) the watch may have ended: WATCH again and re-read what may have been missed.

User sample pipeline (WAV -> 22050 Hz IMA ADPCM slot)
Live device sync: pushes, keep-alive, polling and reload
LIVE pro scene capture, recall and morph
